head_height.value: 25-35mm from chin to crown of head

file_spec.value: 400 x 514 pixels for e-Services upload; accepted formats: jpg, jpeg, heic, heif, png; max 8MB

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open

glasses_policy.value: Glasses permitted if eyes clearly visible with no glare on lenses; dark-tinted or reflective glasses not allowed

face_visibility.value: Full face visible from bottom of chin to top of forehead; both edges of face clearly shown

headwear_policy.value: No headgear unless worn habitually in accordance with religious or racial customs

accessories.value: Photo must not be altered or enhanced in any way

size.evidence: The ICA photo guidelines page (ica.gov.sg/photo-guidelines) specifies 400x514 pixels for digital upload and references ISO/ICAO compliance but does not explicitly state mm dimensions on the fetched page. However, photoaid.com/en-sg/singapore-passport-photo independently confirms '35mm x 45mm' with face between 25-35mm. Multiple other sources (passlens.com, passport-photo-software.com, photobooth.online, passportphotomaker.app) all confirm Singapore passport photos are 35x45mm. The ICAO standard for travel documents is 35x45mm, consistent with ICA's stated ICAO compliance. The claimed dimensions are correct.
